The jscpd settings the gate and CI share: a block of Python written twice fails both.
jscpd keeps a copy when its last line minus its first is minLines or more, so 9 fails a
copy of 10 lines or more. It at times counts the blank lines after a copy too, which makes
the check stricter, never looser. Imports are left out: modules share them, and no fix
Tests are left out, and so is database/, whose migrations keep their own copy of the code
